def tokenize_expression(s, line):
  tokens=[]; i=0; n=len(s)
  while i<n:
    ch=s[i]
    if ch in ' \t\n\r\f\v': i+=1; continue (whitespace inside tags free; maybe all isspace). Use ch.isspace() for simplicity.
    if ch == '-' and i+1<n and s[i+1].isdigit():
       j=i+1; while j<n and s[j].isdigit(): j+=1
       raw=s[i:j]; tokens.append(('int', int(raw), raw)); i=j; continue
    if ch.isdigit():
       j=i; while j<n and s[j].isdigit(): j+=1
       raw=s[i:j]; tokens.append(('int', int(raw), raw)); i=j
    elif ch in ('"', "'"):
       quote=ch; j=i+1; while j<n and s[j] != quote: j+=1
       if j>=n: raise TemplateError(line)
       tokens.append(('string', s[i+1:j], s[i:j+1])); i=j+1
    elif ch.isalpha() or ch == '_':
       j=i; while j<n and (s[j].isalnum() or s[j]=='_'): j+=1
       word=s[i:j]; tokens.append(('name', word, word)); i=j
    else:
       if s.startswith('==', i): tokens.append(('op','==','==')); i+=2
       elif s.startswith('!=', i): tokens.append(('op','!=','!=')); i+=2
       elif ch in '|(),.=': tokens.append(('op',ch,ch)); i+=1
       else: raise TemplateError(line)
  return tokens
